intent.subtype: arithmetic right shift of an unsigned-typed product
intent.rationale: KP is an unsigned constant, so the product is unsigned and >>> shifts in zeros; a negative error yields a large positive term.

labels.note: Unsigned KP makes err_s * KP unsigned, so >>> is a logical shift and negative errors give a wrong term.
